title: docs(kernel): lifecycle page states plugin install is not implemented, drops phantom plugin commands
body:
Fixes #21444

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx` only (prose; no CLI, spec or ADR change).

- States up front (description, intro, the existing warn callout, and a new callout on the Plugin Installation section) that code-plugin installation is not implemented: the `os plugin` group is `build`, `sign` and `publish`, and ADR-0025 records the install half (download, verify, materialize, load) as not yet implemented.
- Removes the `objectstack plugin install` CLI walkthrough, the fabricated install output, and the `config set` / `plugin enable` / `plugin test` next steps. Replaces them with a short "What an author does today" section, drawn from `packages/cli/README.md` (Plugin Management) and the `os package install` / `os package publish --install` command definitions.
- The install flow sketch and state diagram stay, labelled as design (ADR-0025), with no command attached. The dependency refusal text no longer names a command.
- "Atomic Installations" in the Summary is marked as design.
- `objectstack test` respelled `os test` (a real command; `--url` is a real flag). The `objectstack upgrade` lines stay as design intent: the CLI has no `upgrade` command, and the top callout now says so explicitly.

## Commands judged on the page (against packages/cli/src/commands)

| Command on the page | Verdict | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin install` (6 forms, `--enable`, `--config`, `--dry-run`, `--force`) | absent | walkthrough removed |
| `plugin enable`, `plugin test` | absent | removed |
| `config set` | absent (no config command) | removed with the output block |
| `upgrade` (all forms: `--to`, `--strategy`, `--dry-run`, `--production`, `--monitor`) | absent | kept as design intent, covered by the top callout, now explicit |
| `test` | real (`test.ts`; flags `--url`, `--token`, `--fail-on-empty`, `--tags`) | respelled `os test --url …` |
| `os generate migration` (`--format sql`, `--dry-run`) | real | unchanged, already `os` |
| `os migrate plan` / `os migrate apply` | real | unchanged |
| `os package publish … --env … --install` | real | unchanged |
| `os rollback` | absent, page already says removed | unchanged |

## Acceptance notes

- The card says the CLI bin is `os`. `packages/cli/package.json` declares both `objectstack` and `os` under `bin` (oclif `bin` is `os`), so `objectstack` is a working alias, not a wrong binary. The page now uses `os` for real commands as the card asks; the defect is the absent commands, not the spelling.
- Changeset: none. `content/docs/**` publishes no npm package; AGENTS.md step 3 asks for a changeset only for what publishes.

## Checks run

check-doc-frontmatter, check-doc-route-spelling (advisory), check-docs-section-name, check-section-landing-index, check-doc-anchors, check-doc-authoring, check-docs-audit-scope, check-docs-redirects, check-docs-single-h1, check-docs-spec-enumerations, check-docs-transcript-drift (after building @objectstack/lint), check-published-readme-links, check-nul-bytes: all exit 0. Not run: the docs-site `next build` (MDX compile) is left to CI.
